transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. I'm here to help. What brings you in today?

Honestly, Doctor, I have never felt better in my entire life! For the past three months, I've had this incredible surge of energy and an extremely elevated mood where I just feel absolutely unstoppable. I feel this constant, burning need to stay active and keep moving every single second!
Have you ever had experiences where you believed things that others say aren't true, or heard voices that others don't hear?

Yes, I actually have. I sometimes hear whispering voices when there's no one around, and I've believed I had special powers or that people were targeting me, which others said was impossible. These experiences always seem to happen during these times when my energy is through the roof.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "mood episode timing",
  "question": "Do these voices and beliefs go away completely when your mood returns to normal, or do they continue even when you're not feeling highly energized or elevated?"

Yes, they completely go away when my mood goes back to normal. I only hear those voices and have those beliefs when I am feeling incredibly energized and high. Once that intense energy fades, everything returns to normal.
Have you ever experienced any periods of depression, or has your mood stayed elevated for the past three months without a downturn?

I haven't felt depressed at all during this time. For the entire past three months, my mood has stayed consistently elevated, energetic, and sometimes quite irritable, without any downturns. It has just been a non-stop high.

This course is inconsistent with the requirement for persistent psychotic symptoms independent of mood episodes in schizoaffective disorder. The continued presence of a full manic episode with psychotic features, lasting three months without depression, supports Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features as the only remaining candidate.
